patch_description:
Replace the uniformly random configuration with a deterministic multi-start local search specialized for the maximin triangle objective. Four points are fixed at the corners of the unit square, making the convex hull area exactly one and preventing normalization changes from obscuring progress. The remaining nine points begin from perturbed 3-by-3 lattice layouts and are refined using vectorized evaluation of all 286 triangle areas.

The search uses a rank-weighted objective concentrated on the smallest triangle areas rather than only the single current bottleneck. This is substantially more stable than direct random sampling: it lifts several nearly-degenerate triangles simultaneously while retaining the true minimum-area incumbent. Fixed seeds, fixed restart count, and fixed proposal schedule make the returned arrangement reproducible.
